## tal-a31-p08

viṣuvatsthena vinyāso mantrāṇāṃ maṇḍalottame / kāryo@smin pūjite yatra sarveśvarapadaṃ bhajet svastikenātha kartavyaṃ yuktaṃ tasyocyate vidhiḥ / nāḍikāḥ sthāpayetpūrvaṃ muhūrtaṃ parimāṇataḥ śakravāruṇadiksthāśca yāmyasaumyagatāstathā / ekonatriṃśadvaṃśāḥ syurṛjutiryaggatāstathā aṣṭau marmaśatānyekacatvāriṃśacca jāyate / vaṃśairviṣayasaṃkhyaiśca padmaṃ yugmendumaṇḍalam rasasaṃkhyairbhavetpīṭhaṃ svastikaṃ sarvakāmadam / vasusaṃkhyairdvāravīthāvevaṃ bhāgaparikramaḥ randhravipraśarāgnīṃśca lupyedbāhyāntaraṃ kramāt / marmāṇi ca caturdikṣu madhyāddvāreṣu sundari vahnibhūtamunivyomabāhyagarbhe purīṣu ca / lopayeccaiva marmāṇi antarnāḍivivarjitān dvāraprākārakoṇeṣu netrānalaśarānṛtūn / nāḍayo brahmavaṃśasya lopyā netrādrasasthitāḥ vahnernetrānalau lopyau vedānnetrayugaṃ rasāt / netraṃ saumyagataṃ lopyaṃ pūrvādvedānalau rasāt lokasthā nāḍikā hitvā netrādvedāgnayaḥ kramāt / śarairvahnigataṃ caiva yugaṃ netrāgnayo rasāt

## tal-a31-p15

source_text: [and]-netrāt pūrvagatāccaiva sumerurdvārasaṃjñitaḥ / svastikā ca purī ramyā caturdikṣu sthitāvubhau marmaṇāṃ ca śate dve ca ṛṣibhirguṇitā diśaḥ / netrādikāṃśca saṃmārjya mārgamadhyāt suśobhane ṛṣitrayakṛte madhye viṣayaiḥ karṇikā bhavet / netrīkṛtānvasūn patraṃ netraṃ sakṛdvibhājitam vahniṃ vasugataṃ kṛtvā śaśāṅkasthāṃśca lopayet / vahnīṣuṛṣimadhyācca lopyaṃ pīṭhendukāvadhi brahmaṇo netraviṣayānnetrādvedānalau haret / sāgare netrakaṃ lopyaṃ nāḍayaḥ pūrvadiggatāḥ bhūtanetragatānmūrdhnā netrāddvivahnidṛktrikāt / saumyagāt pīṭhakoṇeṣu lopayeta caturṣvapi dalāni kāryāṇi sitaiḥ kesaraṃ raktapītalaiḥ / karṇikā kanakaprakhyā pallavāntāśca lohitāḥ vyomarekhā tu susitā vartulābjāntanīlabhāḥ / pīṭhaṃ rekhātrayopetaṃ sitalohitapītalam svastikāśca caturvarṇā agnerīśānagocarāḥ / vīthī vidrumasaṃkāśā svadikṣvastrāṇi bāhyataḥ indranīlanibhaṃ vajraṃ śaktiṃ padmamaṇiprabhām / daṇḍaṃ hāṭakasaṃkāśaṃ vaktraṃ tasyātilohitam

## tal-a31-p16

source_text: [and]-nīladyutisamaṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ vatsakasaprabham / dhvajaṃ puṣpaphalopetaṃ pañcaraṅgaiśca śobhitam gadā hemanibhātyugrā nānāratnavibhūṣitā / śūlaṃ nīlāmbujasamaṃ jvaladvahnyugraśekharam tasyopari sitaṃ padmamīṣatpītāruṇaprabham / cakraṃ hemanibhaṃ dīptamarā vaiḍūryasaṃnibhāḥ arāmadhyaṃ supītaṃ ca bāhyaṃ jvālāruṇaṃ bhavet / mandiraṃ devadevasya sarvakāmaphalapradam śrīsiddhāyāṃ śūlavidhiḥ prāk kṣetre caturaśrite / hastamātraṃ tridhā sūryānnavakhaṇḍaṃ yathā bhavet madhye śūlaṃ ca tatretthaṃ madhyabhāgaṃ tridhā bhajet / navabhiḥ koṣṭhakairyuktaṃ tato@yaṃ vidhirucyate madhyabhāgatrayaṃ tyaktvā madhye bhāgadvayasya tu / adhastādbhrāmayetsūtraṃ śaśāṅkaśakalākṛti ubhayato bhrāmayettatra yathāgre hākṛtirbhavet / koṭyāṃ tatra kṛtaṃ sūtraṃ nayedrekhāṃ tu pūrvikām aparadvārapūrveṇa tyaktvāṅgulacatuṣṭayam / rekhāṃ vināśayetprājño yathā śūlākṛtirbhavet śūlāgre tvardhahastena tyaktvā padmāni kārayet / adhaḥ śṛṅgatrayaṃ hastamadhye padmaṃ sakarṇikam

source_text: [and]-mukhāgre dhārayetsūtraṃ tribhirhastaistu pātayet / madhye cordhvaṃ tataḥ kuryādadhastādaṅguladvayam rekhādvayaṃ pātayeta yathā śūlaṃ bhavatyapi / adhobhāgādibhiścordhvaṃ tatra rekhā prapadyate samīkṛtya tataḥ sūtre ūrdhve dve evameva tu / madhyaṃ padmaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyaṃ śūlādhastādyaśasvini ityeṣa maṇḍalavidhiḥ kathitaḥ saṃkṣepayogato mahāgurubhiḥ / [AbhT_31.164]
